release_notes:
## 🔐 Security

- The bundled Java runtime is now Eclipse Temurin 25.0.5.1. This fixes [CVE-2026-114938](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-114938) ("Java4Shell") in the Java runtime. All earlier Appsmith images include an affected Java version. Self-hosted instances should upgrade.
use_case: Internal tools, admin panels and database frontends
